title: Ship Theme
description: A user-authored Ship theme. Defines the token bundle a shell renders against. Validated on save by POST /api/themes; lint rule theme-token-ref flags views that reference raw colors instead of var(--token).

id.description: Theme identifier. Kebab-case. Must be unique across bundled + user themes.

label.description: Human-readable name shown in the theme picker.

mode.description: Whether this theme is intended as light or dark. Drives the shell's .dark class toggle.

extends.description: Optional base theme id to inherit tokens from. The `tokens` map overrides selectively.

contrast.description: Optional contrast overrides. When absent the server computes defaults.

minBodyRatio.description: Minimum foreground/background ratio (WCAG). Default 4.5 (AA body text).

minInteractiveRatio.description: Minimum ratio for interactive surfaces (primary on background, etc.). Default 3.

color.description: A CSS color. Allowed forms: hex (#rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa), rgb()/rgba(), oklch()/oklab(), hsl(). No named colors, no raw keywords — every user-visible color must round-trip through a parser.
